payload.prompt: Perform simplified year-end closing for 2025: 1) Calculate and post annual depreciation for three assets: IT-utstyr (204150 NOK, 4 years straight-line, account 1210), Inventar (237550 NOK, 8 years, account 1240), Programvare (307500 NOK, 4 years, account 1250). Use account 6010 for depreciation expense and 1209 for accumulated depreciation. 2) Reverse prepaid expenses (total 44300 NOK on account 1700). 3) Calculate and post tax provision (22% of taxable profit) on account 8700/2920. Post each depreciation as a separate voucher.

payload.goal: Perform simplified year-end closing for 2025 by posting three separate annual depreciation vouchers, reversing prepaid expenses, and posting tax provision at 22% of taxable profit.
likely_resources: trial balance / taxable profit report for 2025
success_checks: Three separate vouchers are posted for 2025 depreciation, one per asset/account
Depreciation amounts are calculated correctly: IT-utstyr 51037.5 NOK, Inventar 29693.75 NOK, Programvare 76875 NOK
Each depreciation voucher debits 6010 and credits 1209 with the correct amount
A voucher reverses prepaid expenses totaling 44300 NOK from account 1700
Tax provision voucher is posted using 8700 and 2920 at 22% of taxable profit
All vouchers are dated within fiscal year 2025 and balanced
risk_notes: Taxable profit amount is not provided; tax provision cannot be calculated numerically without ledger basis
Reversal side for prepaid expenses is not specified; offset account may require source-period detail or original expense account mapping
Using one accumulated depreciation account 1209 for assets on 1240 and 1250 may be nonstandard depending on chart of accounts
Depreciation amounts include decimals; voucher posting may require rounding policy
Need confirmation that full-year depreciation applies for all assets and no acquisition/disposal dates affect 2025 amounts
Year-end closing may require open posting period and correct voucher series
payload.suggested_first_action: Fetch 2025 trial balance / taxable profit and confirm posting date and offset account for prepaid expense reversal before creating vouchers.
ordered_steps: GET accounting year/period status for 2025 and ensure year-end posting date is open
GET 2025 ledger/trial balance to determine taxable profit before tax and identify original prepaid expense offset if needed
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31: debit 6010 51037.5, credit 1209 51037.5 for IT-utstyr depreciation referencing asset account 1210
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31: debit 6010 29693.75, credit 1209 29693.75 for Inventar depreciation referencing asset account 1240
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31: debit 6010 76875, credit 1209 76875 for Programvare depreciation referencing asset account 1250
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31 to reverse prepaid expenses totaling 44300 from account 1700 against the appropriate expense or reversal account after confirmation
Calculate tax provision = taxable_profit * 0.22 from 2025 ledger basis
POST voucher dated 2025-12-31: debit 8700 and credit 2920 for calculated tax provision amount
Verify all vouchers are balanced, posted in 2025, and visible in general ledger

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Find postings corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
Prefer GET /ledger/posting for ledger analysis; aggregate/group endpoints can return empty groups in sandbox.
Use dateFrom and dateTo for date range filtering.
Use count and from for pagination — ALWAYS paginate if fullResultSize > count.
For expense analysis: filter accounts in range 4000-7999 (Norwegian expense accounts).
Response may be truncated — check fullResultSize vs count and paginate if needed.
NEVER send the exact same API call twice simultaneously — deduplicate identical method+path+params requests.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
AUTO-SPLIT RULES: ONLY vatType id=3 (25% utgående) triggers auto-split. vatType id=1 does NOT auto-split.

For supplier costs: use TWO postings — (1) DEBIT expense account with vatType=3 and amountGross=GROSS amount, (2) CREDIT account 2400 with vatType=0 and amountGross=NEGATIVE GROSS amount with supplier ref. Tripletex auto-splits the debit into net+VAT. A SINGLE debit posting with vatType=3 causes 422 on many accounts. ALWAYS include the credit to 2400. Ignore legalVatTypes — vatType=3 works for auto-split even when not listed.
For vatType=0: include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': add matching credit posting with vatType=0, or switch to two-posting approach (debit vatType=3 + credit vatType=0).
NEVER use vatType=1 — it does NOT auto-generate balancing entries and will always cause 422 with single posting.
Do NOT include currency on postings — let it default. Including currency={} causes 'factor must be >= 1' error.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For ANY posting on account 2400 (Leverandørgjeld), ALWAYS include supplier={"id": supplier_id}.
For ANY posting on account 1500 (Kundefordringer), ALWAYS include customer={"id": customer_id}.
Month-end depreciation: debit a 6000-series depreciation expense (e.g., 6010), credit accumulated depreciation (typically 1039/1049/1059) — do NOT credit 1209.
Month-end payroll accrual: derive amount from actual salary transactions/postings in period; NEVER invent a payroll amount.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}. NEVER use account={"number": XXXX} in postings.

payload.trace_example_task: Year-end closing vouchers. 3-6 API calls. Use account numbers from prompt directly.
